connection.title: Frigate & MQTT connection

cameras.title: Cameras & detection
cameras.description: Choose which Frigate cameras YA-WAMF watches. Advanced detection and classifier gates stay in Detection settings.
cameras.detected_note: No camera list set, so YA-WAMF is watching all cameras. These are producing detections:
cameras.gates_hint: Missing detections? Frigate's own min_score / threshold / min_initialized gates decide whether a snapshot ever reaches YA-WAMF.
cameras.list_hint: Use the exact camera names from your Frigate config.

model.title: Classifier model & hardware
model.description: YA-WAMF includes a lightweight CPU fallback. Choose a model, download it here if needed, then validate the exact image and hardware path before continuing.
model.download_required: Download and verify this model here before validating it on this hardware.
model.download_timeout: The download is taking longer than expected. Check the connection and try again.
model.validation_timeout: Hardware validation exceeded 30 minutes. It may still be finishing in Diagnostics; check its status before starting another run.
model.provider_hint: Only providers available in this image, on this host, and for the selected model are shown.
model.results_hint: Full per-device compile, latency, and accuracy detail is in Settings → Debug → Model evaluation harness. The Debug tab appears when the debug UI is enabled (SYSTEM__DEBUG_UI_ENABLED=true).
model.validation_required: Validate this model on the current image and hardware before continuing.
model.location_hint: Validating or continuing saves these coordinates first, using the same feeder location as Settings → Integrations → Location. This model does not use the date or a location accuracy radius.
model.location_incomplete: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
model.location_empty: No location will be used: this model identifies birds without it.
model.incomplete_install: This model install is incomplete. Download and verify it again before continuing.
model.check_running: Continue is available when the check finishes. Leaving this step does not stop the check. Return later to read the saved results.
model.provider_replaced: {previous} did not pass the check for this model, so {provider} is selected instead.
model.no_passing_provider: This model did not pass hardware validation. Review the results and try again before continuing.
model.readiness_retry: The check finished, but model readiness could not be refreshed. Retrying; you can leave this step and return later.
model.best_provider: Best validated provider: {provider}, {ms} ms per image

quality.title: Best available snapshots
quality.description: YA-WAMF can automatically choose the clearest recorded frame and strongest reliable bird crop after each event.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.birdnet_test_subtitle: The staged test uses this URL, then verifies the saved MQTT broker and local detection storage.
integrations.description: Optional add-ons. Enable what you want now; sections that still need credentials are clearly marked in the final review.
integrations.note_ai: Behavioural notes. Add a provider key in Settings.
integrations.note_bw: Report to community stations. Add a station token in Settings.
integrations.note_ebird: Nearby sightings, maps and an optional range filter. Add an API key in Settings.
integrations.note_inat: Owner-reviewed submissions. Connect your account in Settings.
integrations.notifications_note: Notification channels are configured under Settings → Notifications. Home Assistant is installed and configured externally; see the integration guide.

history.title: Import existing detections
history.description: Optionally classify bird events that Frigate still retains. The import runs safely in the background while you finish setup.
history.enable_help: Existing detections are updated only when classification quality improves; saved audio and weather context is preserved.
history.audio_note: Frigate history can restore visual detections and snapshots, but it cannot recreate BirdNET-Go audio that was not already stored.
